Four independently constructed mod-two quotient cellular chain complexes agree with the universal coefficient prediction, including the Tor term.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a sharp combinatorial Hamming-distance criterion and all-code integral homology and fundamental-group classification for a natural family of geometric symmetry quotients. Unlike the simply connected covering components, the quotients support unbounded-rank elementary two-torsion in first homology; rank-two and rank-three examples are nontrivial, reproducible exact cases. These invariants are intrinsic to code quotient topology rather than an arbitrary finite slice or merely renamed known sphere counts.
